context_requirements: Expression of the aspartyl protease renin (REN) or an intact renin-angiotensin system
Presence of angiotensinogen as substrate for renin
A cell type with active renin-dependent angiotensin II generation (e.g., renal juxtaglomerular cells, podocytes, vascular cells)
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines after 10 µM renin inhibitor
Upregulation of REN mRNA or other RAS components in a cell line that lacks measurable renin activity
A shared transcriptional signature across multiple unrelated cell lines that is not explained by renin inhibition

evidence.supports: Renin inhibitor ES-1005 altered kidney renin gene expression in sodium-depleted marmosets, showing renin inhibitors can affect renin transcription in renin-expressing tissue.
Aliskiren reduced extracellular matrix and apoptosis markers in cultured podocytes under high glucose, indicating cell-context-dependent transcriptional effects.
Aliskiren increased pro-angiogenic cells and reduced atherogenesis in mice, but effects were systemic and not shown to be direct transcriptional responses in the tested cell lines.
Aliskiren reduced renal fibrosis markers in a rat obstruction model, again in a tissue context with active renin-angiotensin system.
Aliskiren modulated inflammatory and apoptotic markers in Aβ-treated SH-SY5Y cells, but the mechanism was not clearly renin-dependent.
